name: qlik-desktop-agents
description: Five subagents for Qlik Sense Desktop development — app inspection, load-script writing and review, front-end building, and local engine administration — plus a bundled stdlib-only MCP server that speaks the Qlik Engine JSON API to the local Desktop engine on localhost:4848. Reads and writes the load script, verifies the real loaded data model, reloads apps, and builds sheets and charts that actually render. Needs Qlik Sense Desktop running and Python 3.8+.
